correctness.rationale: Write K=Ind_r(G*K1)=A∪(a*B), B=sk_{r-2}Δ^{n-1}. For every fixed old vertex v, v*B ⊂ A since every set of at most r vertices has all components of size <=r. Hence B→A is nullhomotopic and cofiber gives wedge A∨ΣB, with binom(n-1,r-1) spheres. Relative integral chain homology identifies H~_{r-2}(B)=∧^{r-1}I_G, giving canonical Z[Γ]-exact sequence. In G=K_n,r=n-1, old boundary sphere is sign ε and larger skeleton top homology has regular integral C_n orbit basis from oriented apex-facet boundaries; inclusion is twisted cyclic norm Nε, kernel of multiplication by g−ε. Hom_R(R,Zε)→Hom_R(Zε Nε,Zε) is multiplication by n, so Ext^1_R(Iε,Zε)=Z/n and geometric extension has order n; no equivariant homology or homotopy retraction. Independent exhaustive checks on all 210 graph/r pairs with n=2,3,4 directly verified face decomposition; infinite theorem relies on cofiber/lattice algebra, not finite tests.
